#   php -r '$o = []; foreach (get_declared_classes() as $c) { $r = new ReflectionClass($c); if ($r->isInternal() && $r->implementsInterface("Throwable") && in_array($r->getExtensionName(), ["Core", "standard", "SPL", "json"])) { $o[] = $c . " " . (get_parent_class($c) ?: "Throwable"); } } sort($o); echo implode(PHP_EOL, $o), PHP_EOL;'
